text:
nina (marketing): Quick ask for launch copy: can runtime run a focused bench sweep and hand us provenance + a tiny artifact pack (aggregates + 3 sanitized examples per slice)? Need cold vs warm p50/p95, quant vs fp16 deltas, and a one-line summary we can drop in the blog.

alex (eng-runtime): Yep. Which slices and regions?

nina (marketing): Slices: tiny (<=32t), short (<=128), chat (8-turn), long (2048). Regions: us-west only. Samples: 500 each. Prioritize tiny+chat if time runs out. Include seed and manifest.

kai (eng-runtime): We'll run fp16 + q8_0, burst=10, sustained=3. Cold=first 20 after idle>=600s; warm=5m sustained. We'll attach aggregated_metrics.csv, raw_token_samples.tar.gz (500/sample), demo_examples.json and repro_manifest.txt.

build-bot: job launch-pack-1867778888 queued by alex. ETA ~30m.

alex (eng-runtime): Kickoff command: ./bin/bench_runner --slices tiny,short,chat,long --samples 500 --profiles fp16,q8_0 --region us-west --burst 10 --sustain 3 --seed 99 --out /runs/launch_pack_1867778888

build-bot: job launch-pack-1867778888: completed; artifacts=/runs/launch_pack_1867778888.tar.gz

kai (eng-runtime): Uploads done: https://internal/runs/launch_pack_1867778888.tar.gz. Quick highlights: tiny p95 fp16=36ms q8_0=46ms (cost -~30%); chat p95 fp16=70ms q8_0=84ms; long p95 fp16=495ms q8_0=620ms. Failures <0.2% due to one node hitting IO on long runs.

alex (eng-runtime): Suggested one-line blog copy: "Quantized variants cut per-token cost by ~30% with modest p95 increases on short and interactive workloads; long-context tails require careful tuning."

nina (marketing): Perfect. Paste the exact manifest fields you included so legal can verify.

kai (eng-runtime): Manifest fields: run_id, timestamp, git_sha, model_variant, quant_profile, region, slice_name, sample_count, seed, warm_window_s, cold_idle_s, raw_token_log_path, aggregated_metrics_path, demo_examples_path, checksum_sha256. All strings in repro_manifest.txt inside the tar.gz.

nina (marketing): Great 94 will draft copy and ping for fact-check. Thanks team! :rocket:
